import ast
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
FIXED = ROOT.with_name('LogAnalysisSkill-a0-43a6aa6')
E = ROOT / 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/part3/erratum8'
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools'))
from terminal_scan import fixed_inputs, ModuleIndex, contexts, write_atomic

mode = sys.argv[1]
if mode == 'summary':
    raw = (E/'preflight-final.json').read_bytes()
    result = json.loads(raw)
    old = json.loads((E.parent/'erratum7/preflight-final.json').read_bytes())
    assert {e['path'] for e in result['entries']} == {e['path'] for e in old['entries']}
    assert result['zero_matches'] == result['multiple_matches'] == result['parse_errors'] == []
    closure = []
    for previous in old['zero_matches']:
        points = [p for p in result['participants'] if all(p[k] == previous[k] for k in ('path','line','column'))]
        excluded = [p for p in result['excluded_annotations'] if all(p[k] == previous[k] for k in ('path','line','column'))]
        assert bool(points) != bool(excluded)
        expected = 'EXCLUDED_ANNOTATION' if excluded else points[0]['forms'][0]
        assert expected in {'C8c','C5f','EXCLUDED_ANNOTATION'}
        closure.append({'old':previous, 'resolution':expected})
    counts = Counter(r['resolution'] for r in closure)
    assert counts == {'C8c':23,'C5f':2,'EXCLUDED_ANNOTATION':2}
    bindings = result['alias_bindings']
    keys = [(b['binding']['path'], b['binding']['scope_line'], b['binding']['scope'], b['binding']['name']) for b in bindings]
    assert len(keys) == len(set(keys))
    assert all(b['source_reads'] for b in bindings)
    print('SAME_PY_SOURCE_ENTRY_SET=PASS')
    print('SCAN05_CLOSURE='+json.dumps(counts, sort_keys=True))
    print('BINDING_KEYS_UNIQUE=PASS')
    print('SUMMARY='+json.dumps(result['summary'],sort_keys=True))
    print('ALIAS_RESOLVER_EVENTS='+json.dumps(Counter(e['kind'] for e in result['module_resolution_events']),sort_keys=True))
    print('PREFLIGHT_SHA256='+hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
    lines = ['# 勘误 8 E8-6 全树预检', '',
        '范围:固定 43a6aa6 的全部 PY_SOURCE;不是完整扫描闭合证明。',
        '', '## 汇总', '', '```json', json.dumps(result['summary'],ensure_ascii=False,indent=2), '```',
        '', '## 别名不动点', '', '| 绑定(路径:作用域行:名称) | 来源读取 | 经别名调用点 |', '|---|---|---|']
    for row in bindings:
        b=row['binding']
        sources='; '.join(f"{s['path']}:{s['line']}:{s['column']} {s['qualified_name']}" for s in row['source_reads'])
        calls='; '.join(f"{c['path']}:{c['line']}:{c['column']}" for c in row['calls']) or '无'
        lines.append(f"| {b['path']}:{b['scope_line']} {b['scope']}.{b['name']} | {sources} | {calls} |")
    lines += ['', '## 新增未决(未销账)', '', '| 类别 | 位置 | 原因 |', '|---|---|---|']
    for row in result['dynamic_unresolved']:
        lines.append(f"| {row['category']} | {row['path']}:{row['line']}:{row['column']} | {row['detail']} |")
    lines += ['', '## 零/多命中', '', 'zero_matches=[]; multiple_matches=[]。', '',
              '旧 SCAN-05 的 27 处:23 处 C8c、2 处 C5f、2 处标注位置排除;逐条见 scan05-closure.json。',
              '第 1 块继续核对后新发现 SCAN-06,见 blockers.md;未宣告 full scan completion。', '']
    (E/'preflight-summary.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines))
    write_atomic(E/'scan05-closure.json', closure)
elif mode == 'scan06':
    manifest, files = fixed_inputs(FIXED, ROOT)
    index = ModuleIndex(files, contexts(files))
    module='tizen_convergence_judge'
    path=index.by_name[('.',module)][0]
    tree=ast.parse(files[path].decode())
    binding='check_convergence'
    imports=[(n,a) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom) for a in n.names if (a.asname or a.name)==binding]
    assert len(imports)==1
    all_values=[ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='__all__' for t in n.targets)]
    assert len(all_values)==1 and binding in all_values[0]
    entry=next(e for e in manifest['entries'] if e['path']=='.importlinter')
    assert entry['entry_kind']=='OTHER_TEXT'
    text=files['.importlinter'].decode()
    pattern=re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.])'+re.escape(module)+r'(?![A-Za-z0-9_])')
    hits=[]
    for line, content in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1):
        for match in pattern.finditer(content):
            hits.append({'file':'.importlinter','line':line,'column':match.start(),'line_text':content,
                         'module':module, 'name_form':'DOTTED_MODULE', 'context':'.',
                         'entry_kind':'OTHER_TEXT','forms':[], 'result':'UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY'})
    assert hits
    result={'head':manifest['head'],'tree':manifest['tree'],'scope':'SCAN-06 single-witness check, not full name-backstop enumeration',
            'candidate_id':path+'#REEXPORT#'+binding,'candidate_module':module,
            'candidate_import_line':imports[0][0].lineno,
            'candidate_source':ast.get_source_segment(files[path].decode(),imports[0][0]),
            'all_contains_binding':True,'provider_entry':entry,
            'hits':hits, 'disposition':'NOT_RUN; discovery cannot pre-filter retained entry packages'}
    write_atomic(E/'scan06-witness.json',result)
    print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    print('SCAN-06=BLOCKED: OTHER_TEXT name hits have no C7a/C7b/C7c/C7d form or documented exclusion')
    sys.exit(1)
elif mode == 'immutable':
    paths=['docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data/predicates.json',
           'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data/measurement_exemptions.json']
    for path in paths:
        old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','8046ecc:'+path],cwd=ROOT)
        assert (ROOT/path).read_bytes()==old
        value=json.loads(old)
        canonical=json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
        print(path+' canonical='+hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest()+' UNCHANGED')
    changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','8046ecc'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines()
    assert not [p for p in changed if p.startswith(('tizen-','ci_triage/','release-v1.4.0/'))]
    assert not [p for p in changed if '/a0-evidence/' in p]
    print('PRODUCTION_DIFF=0 OLD_EVIDENCE_DIFF=0')
    print('FIXED_WORKTREE_STATUS='+subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all'],cwd=FIXED,text=True).strip())
